reason: Most of our endcaps and displays are proposed and paid for by the brands, and I just approve placement and fix things myself on weekend visits. Locking in almost a million pesos a year, at the 10-store minimum for 12 months, to simulate layouts we mostly don't design ourselves is hard to justify, especially from a company with no results yet.
objection: Our CCTV is old and low resolution. I don't believe it can track shoppers well enough to build a simulation I'd trust, and nobody has shown it working in a store like ours.
would_change_my_mind: A free or paid-on-results pilot in 2-3 of our own stores, using our existing old cameras, that shows a real sales lift, with no 12-month lock-in.
